sentences.en: A The conviction that historical relics provide infallible testimony about the past is rooted in the nineteenth and early twentieth centuries, when science was regarded as objective and value free.
sentences.zh: 历史遗迹对过去提供了无可置疑的证据,这种信念植根于十九世纪和二十世纪初,当时科学被视为客观和无价值。

sentences.en: As one writer observes: ‘Although it is now evident that artefacts are as easily altered as chronicles, public faith in their veracity endures: a tangible relic seems ipso facto real.’ Such conviction was, until recently, reflected in museum displays.
sentences.zh: 正如一位作家所说: “ 虽然现在可以明显看到,艺术品很容易被篡改,就像古迹一样,但公众对其真实性的信心会持续:有形的遗迹似乎当然是真实的。 ”直到最近,这种信念还在博物馆展出。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Museums used to look – and some still do – much like storage rooms of objects packed together in showcases: good for scholars who wanted to study the subtle differences in design, but not for the ordinary visitor, to whom it all looked alike.
sentences.zh: 博物馆过去看 — — 有些现在仍然看 — — 更像是存放在展品中堆在一起的物品的储藏室:对于想研究设计微妙差异的学者来说,是件好事,但对于普通访客来说并非如此,而普通访客看起来都是一样的。

sentences.en: Good examples of this approach in the UK are the Jorvik Centre in York; the National Museum of Photography, Film and Television in Bradford; and the Imperial War Museum in London.
sentences.zh: 联合王国采用这种做法的好例子有:约克约尔维克中心、布拉德福德国家摄影、电影和电视博物馆和伦敦帝国战争博物馆。

sentences.en: In the US the trend emerged much earlier: Williamsburg has been a prototype for many heritage developments in other parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 在美国,这一趋势早早出现:威廉斯堡是世界其他地区许多遗产发展的原型。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: No one can predict where the process will end.

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: On so-called heritage sites the re-enactment of historical events is increasingly popular, and computers will soon provide virtual reality experiences, which will present visitors with a vivid image of the period of their choice, in which they themselves can act as if part of the historical environment.
sentences.zh: 在所谓的遗产遗址上,重新出现历史事件越来越受欢迎,计算机不久将提供虚拟现实经验,这将给游客提供他们选择的时期的生动形象,使他们自己可以像历史环境的一部分一样采取行动。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句

sentences.en: Such developments have been criticised as an intolerable vulgarisation, but the success of many historical theme parks and similar locations suggests that the majority of the public does not share this opinion.
sentences.zh: 这些发展被批评为不可容忍的粗俗化,但许多历史主题公园和类似地点的成功表明,大多数公众不同意这一观点。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: C In a related development, the sharp distinction between museum and heritage sites on the one hand, and theme parks on the other, is gradually evaporating.
sentences.zh: C 在与此相关的一个发展中,博物馆和遗产遗址与主题公园之间的鲜明区别正在逐渐消失。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: For example, museums have adopted story lines for exhibitions, sites have accepted ‘theming’ as a relevant tool, and theme parks are moving towards more authenticity and research-based presentations.
sentences.zh: 例如,博物馆为展览采用了故事系列,网站接受`它们 ' 作为相关工具,主题公园正在走向更真实和以研究为基础的展示。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In zoos, animals are no longer kept in cages, but in great spaces, either in the open air or in enormous greenhouses, such as the jungle and desert environments in Burgers’ Zoo in Holland.
sentences.zh: 在动物园中,动物不再被关在笼子里,而是在广阔的空间,无论是在露天还是在巨大的温室中,如荷兰Burgers动物园的丛林和沙漠环境。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This particular trend is regarded as one of the major developments in the presentation of natural history in the twentieth century.
sentences.zh: 这一趋势被视为二十世纪自然历史介绍方面的主要发展之一。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: D Theme parks are undergoing other changes, too, as they try to present more serious social and cultural issues, and move away from fantasy.
sentences.zh: D主题公园也在经历其他变化,因为它们试图提出更严重的社会和文化问题,并摆脱幻想。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This development is a response to market forces and, although museums and heritage sites have a special, rather distinct, role to fulfil, they are also operating in a very competitive environment, where visitors make choices on how and where to spend their free time.
sentences.zh: 这一发展是对市场力量的一种反应,尽管博物馆和遗产遗址可以发挥特殊、相当不同的作用,但它们也在竞争激烈的环境中运作,游客在这种环境中选择如何和在何处自由使用时间。

sentences.en: Heritage and museum experts do not have to invent stories and recreate historical environments to attract their visitors: their assets are already in place.
sentences.zh: 遗产和博物馆专家不必发明故事和创造历史环境来吸引游客:他们的资产已经到位。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: However, exhibits must be both based on artefacts and facts as we know them, and attractively presented.
sentences.zh: 然而,证物必须既基于我们所知的手工艺品,也基于事实,而且必须具有吸引力。

sentences.en: Those who are professionally engaged in the art of interpreting history are thus in a difficult position, as they must steer a narrow course between the demands of ‘evidence’ and ‘attractiveness’, especially given the increasing need in the heritage industry for income-generating activities.

sentences.en: Castles, palaces and cathedrals have a longer lifespan than the dwellings of ordinary people.
sentences.zh: 城堡、宫殿和教堂的寿命比普通人的住宅长。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The same applies to the furnishings and other contents of the premises.
sentences.zh: 家具和其他物品也适用同样的规定。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In a town like Leyden in Holland, which in the seventeenth century was occupied by approximately the same number of inhabitants as today, people lived within the walled town, an area more than five times smaller than modern Leyden.
sentences.zh: 荷兰的莱登镇在十七世纪被大约与今天相同数量的居民占领,在荷兰的莱登镇等城镇,人们生活在围墙城内,这个地区比现代莱登小五倍多。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: In most of the houses several families lived together in circumstances beyond our imagination.
sentences.zh: 在大多数房屋中,几个家庭共同生活,但情况超出我们的想象。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Yet in museums, fine period rooms give only an image of the lifestyle of the upper class of that era.
sentences.zh: 然而在博物馆里, 美时房间只给人一个时代上层阶层生活方式的画面。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: No wonder that people who stroll around exhibitions are filled with nostalgia; the evidence in museums indicates that life was so much better in the past.
sentences.zh: 难怪在展览会周围闲逛的人充满了怀旧;博物馆中的证据表明,过去的生活比以往好得多。

sentences.zh: 这一概念的产生是由于博物馆和遗产中心中存在偏见。
